name: tikbet
description: Génération automatique de vidéos TikTok de pronostics avec Remotion

scripts.audio:500k: npx tsx scripts/export-timeline-500k.ts /tmp/timeline-500k.json && python3 scripts/gen-audio.py /tmp/timeline-500k.json public/promo500k/bande-son.wav
scripts.audio:secrets: npx tsx scripts/export-secrets.ts /tmp/secrets-tl && mkdir -p public/secrets && for f in /tmp/secrets-tl/*.json; do python3 scripts/gen-audio.py $f public/secrets/$(basename $f .json).wav; done
